name: Ricardo Velez
bio:
Ricardo's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. A civil engineering graduate from the National University of Colombia, he initially designed bridges and infrastructure. However, a chance encounter with a local racing team needing structural analysis expertise led him down a different path. He quickly became captivated by the blend of precision engineering and high-stakes competition. Over the years, he transitioned from providing technical support to leading operational teams, his experience in infrastructure giving him a unique perspective on logistics and efficiency.

At Red Bull Racing, Ricardo emphasizes a meticulous approach to operations, believing that every detail, from pit stop choreography to supply chain management, can contribute to marginal gains. He values clear communication and proactive problem-solving, fostering a collaborative environment where his team feels empowered to voice concerns and suggest improvements. His distinctive blend of engineering rigor and hands-on experience allows him to anticipate challenges and implement solutions before they escalate, making him a crucial asset to the team's overall success.

physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Insists on personally inspecting the garage setup before every race weekend.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, often driving his colleagues slightly crazy.
